Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-incident data integrity confirmation

Hi Rajiv,

Quick update following the service incident we discussed on July 17.

Engineering completed the initial forensic pass this morning. We're running a deeper integrity validation across the affected request window and the surrounding 48-hour period. Scope of checks underway:
- S3 access logs (object GET/PUT) across buckets used for your account
- Database transaction logs and row counts for the impacted tenant DB
- KV cache hit/miss and TTL anomalies
- Authentication logs (token issuance/refresh) and IAM policy changes
- Network egress patterns and outbound connection summaries

We'll deliver a short executive summary first and then a detailed appendix with the raw logs (redacted where necessary). Target for the executive confirmation: 2026-07-20 EOD (PST).

If there are particular artifacts you want prioritized (e.g., user mailboxes, specific model IDs), flag them and we'll include them in the first pass.

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none at this time

Subject: Post-incident data integrity confirmation — FinServ (final)

Hi Rajiv,

Thanks again for your patience. Per our commitment, engineering and our security team completed the full integrity validation covering 2026-07-17T02:00:00Z through 2026-07-19T02:00:00Z. Below is the executive summary; attached are the redacted appendices (S3 access report, DB tx counts, authentication event export).

Executive summary (high level):
- S3 object access: We reviewed 2,134 GET/PUT events related to your tenant during the window. Every GET/PUT maps to an authenticated session tied to your tenant's workload tokens. No events show external principals accessing those objects.
- Database integrity: Row counts and transaction digests match pre-incident snapshots. A checksum comparison across the affected tables (sha256 per-row summary) returned identical results to the pre-incident baseline.
- Authentication and egress: No unusual token issuance patterns or outbound connections were observed. Egress flows to third-party destinations do not include your tenant data.
- Audit conclusion: There is no evidence of data loss or unauthorized exfiltration affecting FinServ tenant data based on the checks performed. We will keep extended logs available for 90 days and can provide additional artifacts subject to NDA.

Attachments (redacted):
- finserv_s3_access_report_redacted.csv
- finserv_db_integrity_checks.pdf
- finserv_auth_events_export_redacted.csv

Related links:
- Investigation docket (internal): https://redwood.app/links/INV-2026-07-FS-09
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/FinServ+Solutions

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough with our security team to go over the appendix and answer auditor questions.

Best,
